entry.name: live.scope~
entry.description: Use live.scope~ to visualize an audio signal. This object can be used as an alternative to scope~.

attributes.name: active
attributes.description: The active state

attributes.name: activebgcolor
attributes.description: Sets the background color in RGBA format, when theattribute is set to 1.

attributes.name: activegridcolor
attributes.description: Sets the grid color in RGBA format, when theattribute is set to 1.

attributes.name: activelinecolor
attributes.description: Sets the color of the waveform line in RGBA format, when theattribute is set to 1.

attributes.name: grid
attributes.description: Sets which grid lines to display. Possible values are:0: off1: horizontal2: vertical3: horizontal and verticalIf 1 (horizontal) is selected, the x-axis is segmented, giving you horizontal divisions of the grid. If 2 (vertical) is selected, the y-axis is segmented, giving you vertical divisions of the grid.

attributes.name: grid_line_width
attributes.description: The width of the grid lines. The defult value is 1.

attributes.name: gridcolor
attributes.description: Sets the grid color in RGBA format, when theattribute is set to 0.

attributes.name: horizontal_divisions
attributes.description: The amount of grid divisions on the x-axis. To view these divisions, theattribute must be set to either 'horizontal' or 'horizontal and vertical'.

attributes.name: ignoreclick
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: interval
attributes.description: Sets the time in milliseconds that the waveform drawing is updated.

attributes.name: jspainterfile
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: line_width
attributes.description: The width of the waveform line. The defult value is 1.

attributes.name: linecolor
attributes.description: Sets the color of the waveform line in RGBA format, when theattribute is set to 0.

attributes.name: mode
attributes.description: Sets the drawing mode for. There are two possible modes: history and trigger. History mode captures and displays the last N samples, whereas trigger mode captures and displays based on an external trigger signal that is sent to the second inlet. When in trigger mode, you can adjust the attributesand. When the signal in the second inlet passes thevalue, live.scope~ will start capturing the signal from the first inlet.

attributes.name: range
attributes.description: The minimum and maximum amplitude that is displayed in theobject. When the amplitude exceeds the specified range, the visual display is clipped.

attributes.name: rect
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: rounded
attributes.description: The amount the corners of theobject are rounded. Possible values are 0-10.

attributes.name: samples
attributes.description: Sets the number of samples to capture.

attributes.name: size
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: smooth
attributes.description: Theattribute allows you to visually smooth a waveform's lines. There are three values for this attribute: off, type 1, and type 2.Off: No smoothing applied. Without smoothing, low frequency waveforms might look rough. However, for high and complex frequency waveforms, not using any smoothing will show the most accurate results.Type 1: Improves visual appearance while also retaining as much accuracy as possible.Type 2: The most visually pleasing at low frequencies, however, at higher frequencies, the accuracy decreases significantely.

attributes.name: textcolor
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: textjustification
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: trigger_direction
attributes.description: The direction the trigger signal needs to be traveling, when passing the trigger threshold, in order to trigger a new waveform drawing. i.e. if the direction is set to 'up', and the treshold is set to '0', a new waveform will be drawn when the signal passes 0, while moving towards +1. This attribute works in conjunction with theattribute.must be set to 'trigger' for either attribute to function.

attributes.name: trigger_threshold
attributes.description: Sets the trigger threshold value. This is the value the trigger signal (connected to the second inlet of) must pass in order to trigger a new waveform drawing. This attribute works in conjunction with theattribute.must be set to 'trigger' for either attribute to function.

attributes.name: varname
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: vertical_divisions
attributes.description: The amount of grid divisions on the y-axis. To view these divisions, theattribute must be set to either 'vertical' or 'horizontal and vertical'.

messages.name: bang
messages.description: When sent to either inlet of, a bang will trigger a new waveform drawing.

messages.name: signal
messages.description: Left inlet: signal to display inRight inlet: trigger signal
